To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the release of low molecular weight bioactive compounds from polystyrene beads can be controlled by adjusting the cross-linking density of the polymer matrix and by varying the composition of the beads.

(a) the PS-DVB biocide beads have been successfully synthesized, (b) the biocide release is strongly dependent on the biocide composition and the cross-linking density, and (c) the FT-Raman and ATR-FTIR spectra of the beads before and after the biocide release have been recorded.

the release of low molecular weight antimicrobial agents, like Triclosan or phosphonium salts, from polystyrene beads can be controlled by the DVB and the antimicrobial composition ratios in the beads.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the preparation of a new class of PS-DVB beads containing biocides with controlled release characteristics.
the development of novel PS-DVB biocide beads that could be used as an alternative to conventional antimicrobial agents in the treatment of medical devices.
the preparation of PS-DVB beads with controlled release biocide properties.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
both the DVB and the biocide composition ratios in the PS-DVB bead formulation are the key factors that control the release of the biocides from the PS-DVB polymer network.
the PS-DVB biocide beads, with controlled release characteristics, can be used for the preparation of biocidal materials with enhanced antimicrobial properties.
both the DVB and the biocide composition ratios in the PS-DVB bead formulation are the key parameters that control the release rate of the biocide out of the beads.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the PS-DVB-beads can be used as an efficient delivery system for biocidal agents, which can be released in controlled rates into the surrounding liquid medium.
the biocide release rate out of the PS/DVB matrix is a function of the biocide incorporation level and of the cross-linking density of the PS-DVBe beads.

a higher biocide concentration in the beads and a lower cross-linking density of the PS-DVD matrix are the most important factors for the efficient release of the biocides out into the liquid mixtures.
The main takeaway from our work is that
PS-DVB beads with a controlled biocide release can be easily obtained by changing the DVB and the biocide composition ratio in the starting mixture.
the biocide migration rate from the PS-DVB matrix is dependent on both the cross-linking density and the antimicrobial agent concentration in the beads.

the PS-DVB biocides can be used as an alternative to the conventional biocides, which are currently employed for the prevention of microbial growth in medical and pharmaceutical devices, and that the release of these biocides can potentially be controlled by varying the composition of the PS-DVBe beads.
